capabilities: assign multi-chord sequence hotkeys to commands
search and filter commands when choosing a hotkey
confirm a sequence with Enter or the check button
insert Enter or Escape into a sequence via a plus button
extras: The author states they no longer use Obsidian much and will likely not maintain the repo going forward. Known issues: sequences starting with an already-bound chord do not trigger, and non-QWERTY keyboard layouts like Dvorak are not supported.
intentEvidence: use a sequences of chords for shortcuts instead of single chords
problem: Obsidian only supports single-chord hotkeys, so there is no built-in way to trigger commands with a sequence of chords.
summary: Hotkey manager that lets you assign multi-chord key sequences, instead of single chords, to Obsidian commands.
